items.summary: Says he will place all state expenditures in an online database with transaction-level detail and near real-time reporting.

citations.quote: I will deliver for the people by placing all expenditures in an easy-to-use online database with transaction-level detail and near real-time reporting, so every Californian can see exactly how public funds are used.

items.summary: His campaign site says California has never conducted a full audit of its social services system and that he will demand audits.
items.title: Full audit of the social services system

citations.quote: California has never conducted a full, top-to-bottom audit of its social services system—despite historic fraud losses. Herb Morgan will demand real audits, not excuses.
